54. I was given the impression, from my conversations with Mr Cheung, that he or others responsible had inspected the FS Water Tanks, and would ensure that the FH/HR system was properly shut down.

55. Based on Gordon’s and / or Mr Cheung’s representations, I honestly believed that:

(a) Proper inspection had been carried out; and  
(b) there were leakage problems with the FS Water Tanks.

56. Given our previous dealings, which had proceeded without issue, I had no reason to doubt them.

SDN Applications and Renewals

57. In general, for applications of SDN in the Wang Fuk Court project:

(a) I signed the SDN application forms; and  
(b) Mr Yim signed the Forms FS 251.

58. After signing, Ms Daisy Chung sent the documents to the FSD by fax.

59. I instructed Daisy to record the expiry dates of each 14-day SDN period and to remind me. Hence, I could make the renewal application accordingly.

60. Before each renewal, I would communicate with Mr Cheung to check whether the repair works had been completed.

61. I also instructed Mr Cheung to notify me immediately once the works were completed, and he agreed to do so. Nonetheless, Mr Cheung had never notified me that the works were completed.

62. I confirm that no Form FS 251 was ever submitted to lift the suspension of the FH/HR system.
